name: Listbox
description: Shows an inline, keyboard-navigable list of options with no trigger of its own.

value.description: Selected value (controlled); an array when multiple

onValueChange.description: Called with the picked value, or the new array when multiple

multiple.description: Each pick toggles its option; value is an array

disabled.description: Disables every option and removes the list from the tab order

when: Any list the user drives with arrow keys
whenNot: A list nobody selects from (use List)
guidelines: Selection lives on the root: value / onValueChange, single or multiple
Arrows, Home, End, Enter, and Space are handled for you
Always supply Listbox.Empty as a direct child for the no-match case
Group once the list draws from more than one source
accessibility: Uses listbox and option roles with aria-activedescendant; one row is highlighted at a time
aria-selected marks picks, and a check repeats it without colour
aria-multiselectable is set in multiple mode
Listbox.Empty is a status line beside the listbox, never a fake option
Connect to an input with aria-controls for the full combobox pattern

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Single selection owned by the root.
examples.code:
<Listbox aria-label="Options" defaultValue="first">
  <Listbox.Item value="first">First option</Listbox.Item>
  <Listbox.Item value="second">Second option</Listbox.Item>
  <Listbox.Item value="third">Third option</Listbox.Item>
</Listbox>

examples.name: Controlled
examples.description: The owner holds the value and hears every pick.
examples.code:
const [repo, setRepo] = React.useState("web");

<Listbox aria-label="Repository" value={repo} onValueChange={setRepo}>
  <Listbox.Item value="web">fragments-sdk/web</Listbox.Item>
  <Listbox.Item value="api">fragments-sdk/api</Listbox.Item>
</Listbox>

examples.name: Multiple
examples.description: Each pick toggles; the value is an array.
examples.code:
<Listbox aria-label="Labels" multiple defaultValue={['bug', 'ui']}>
  <Listbox.Item value="bug">Bug</Listbox.Item>
  <Listbox.Item value="ui">UI</Listbox.Item>
  <Listbox.Item value="docs">Docs</Listbox.Item>
</Listbox>

examples.name: With Groups
examples.description: Labelled sections once the list draws from more than one source.
examples.code:
<Listbox aria-label="Fruit">
  <Listbox.Group label="Orchard">
    <Listbox.Item value="apple">Apple</Listbox.Item>
    <Listbox.Item value="pear">Pear</Listbox.Item>
  </Listbox.Group>
  <Listbox.Group label="Stone fruit">
    <Listbox.Item value="plum">Plum</Listbox.Item>
  </Listbox.Group>
</Listbox>

examples.name: Empty State
examples.description: A status line, not an option.

examples.name: With Disabled Items
examples.description: A disabled option is skipped by the keyboard and never picked.

relations.note: Pair with Input for search/autocomplete patterns
Use Menu when you need a trigger button
Use Select for form field selection
Use List for static, non-interactive lists
